description: Fill visible Android form fields using semantic UI selectors, optionally clear existing text, and optionally tap a uniquely identified submit button. Refreshes the hierarchy between fields. Ambiguous or missing matches fail safely.

clearExisting.description: Clear existing text before typing (default true; sends up to 200 delete key events).

fields.description: Form fields with a unique selector and value.

submit.description: Optional unique submit button selector, tapped after all fields are filled.

name: fill_form
title: Fill Form
